title: Geoffrey Fuller: Prevention of future deaths report

organisation.name: Department of Health and Social Care

report.title: Geoffrey Fuller: Prevention of future deaths report

earlier.title: Kevin Woods: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

matches.explanation: Both reports identify prolonged ambulance handover delays as a hazard that increases mortality risk by reducing ambulance availability.
matches.earlier_quote: Continuing average handover delays (and therefore response delays) which create a risk of future deaths. The averages conceal spikes of delayed handover and ambulance response times which increase the risk of mortality.
matches.later_quote: These handover delays lead to the unavailability of ambulances to respond to emergency calls. Furthermore, the average handover delays conceal spikes such as that which led to the long delay in this case.

promises.quote: making space for a Clinical Decision Unit model, for patients who need more clinical care but don't need to be admitted to hospital
promises.summary: Create a Clinical Decision Unit to provide care without admission

promises.quote: converting the Same Day Medical Assessment Unit (SDMA) to a Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC) and having a triage process to ensure only patients considered as same day go to the SDEC
promises.summary: Convert SDMA to SDEC with triage for same-day patients

earlier.title: Andrew Waters: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
earlier.area: Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly

matches.explanation: Both reports highlight significant ambulance handover delays at the hospital causing ambulances to be unavailable and increasing mortality risk.
matches.earlier_quote: Significant handover delays leading to ambulance resources being tied up at hospital with increased risk in mortality for patients in the community waiting for emergency ambulances

promises.quote: The NHS planning guidance also includes an implementation target for improving A&E waiting times compared to 2024/25, with a minimum of 78% of patients seen within 4 hours in March 2026 and increasing the proportion of patients admitted, discharged, and transferred from an emergency department within 12 hours across 2025/26 compared to 2024/25.
promises.summary: Set A&E target of 78% seen within 4 hours by March 2026 and improve 12‑hour discharge/transfer rates.

earlier.title: Harry Dunn: Prevention of Future Deaths Report (1)

matches.explanation: Both reports identify ambulance handover delays at emergency departments as a safety issue. They link these delays to reduced ambulance availability and increased risk of patient mortality.
matches.earlier_quote: I am concerned that these continuing delays for ambulances at hospital handovers reflects a risk of deaths into the future.
matches.later_quote: These handover delays lead to the unavailability of ambulances to respond to emergency calls. Furthermore, the average handover delays conceal spikes such as that which led to the long delay in this case.

promises.quote: the Health Secretary has ordered a full and independent investigation into NHS performance to provide a frank assessment of the issues and challenges it faces

earlier.title: Lynda Blackmore: Prevention of future deaths report

matches.explanation: Both reports identify ambulance handover delays as prolonging patient wait times for emergency treatment or conveyance to hospital. They describe the same mechanism—excessive handover times reducing ambulance availability and increasing mortality risk.
matches.earlier_quote: My concern here Is that handover delays are impacting upon response times in respect of patients requiring emergency treatment &/or conveyance to hospital.
matches.later_quote: Significant handover delays 1. The court noted that the NHS national target is for ambulances to handover patients to hospital is within 15 minutes of arrival.

promises.quote: We have produced several guidelines to help clinicians treating children presenting with fever and symptoms such as those in the case of Sienna. These include; fever in under 5s: assessment and initial management [NG143], sepsis: recognition, diagnosis and early management [NG51] and sore throat (acute): antimicrobial prescribing [NG84].
promises.summary: Produced clinical guidelines for fever, sepsis, and sore throat management

matches.later_quote: On arrival at Royal Cornwall Hospital (RCHT), Mr Fuller spent a further 2 hours and 52 minutes before being handed over to the emergency department.

earlier.title: Bernard Lyon: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

matches.explanation: Both reports highlight significant delays in transferring patients from ambulance crews to hospital emergency departments. They describe how these delays affect ambulance availability and patient care.
matches.earlier_quote: The evidence given to the inquest indicated significant delays in the handover from the ambulance to the ED team. This was due to pressure on the ED but meant that ambulances were tied up for longer than necessary and then had a knock on impact on the ability of the ambulance service to respond to calls.
